headline: Opening hook builds well, but the problem setup and tower CTA drop the face anchor at the wrong moments

moment.what_happens: Black-and-white footage and old photos illustrate the golden era of hall nights.
moment.brain_response: Scenes signal peaks at its highest point here, and overall stays well above typical. With sound off, engagement falls to near zero, meaning the nostalgia payoff is almost entirely word-driven.
moment.suggestion: Cut in one second of her reacting to the photos to give the visual track a face anchor that holds without the narration.
